description: Use this after the person has picked which businesses to ask (one to five, from find_local_business or get_business_details) and said whether they want an appointment or a quote. It returns a ShoreGrade link with exactly those businesses selected. It sends nothing and records nothing: the person opens the link, describes the job, adds their name and mobile number, confirms a texted code, and submits on ShoreGrade. Do not pass their name, phone, address or job description; this tool has no field for them. Use the slugs or page URLs exactly as returned; a business that cannot take the request type is refused by name, never replaced. The answer says whether requests are open right now; tell the person what it says and do not promise a reply or a time.

businesses.description: The ShoreGrade page URLs or slugs the person chose, 1 to 5.

include_nearby.description: True only when the person agreed to businesses in towns next to "town".

request_type.description: "appointment" to book a visit (salons, barbers, tire shops), "quote" to ask for a price (trades such as plumbers and roofers). Each business's request_types says which it takes.

town.description: The town the work is for. Every chosen business must be listed in it, unless include_nearby is true.
